mainEntity.name: How do I choose fixtures and finishes for an ADU bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing fixtures and finishes for an ADU bathroom involves balancing aesthetics, durability, and budget. It's important to consider the overall style of the ADU and main property to maintain a cohesive look. A key Decision Factor is the intended use of the ADU; a rental unit might benefit from more durable, easy-to-clean materials, while a guest suite could allow for more personalized or luxurious choices. Researching water-efficient fixtures can also provide long-term savings on utility bills. Always check if your chosen materials meet local building codes, especially for shower surrounds and flooring.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose ADU bathroom fixtures and finishes by balancing aesthetics, durability, and budget, considering the ADU's intended use. Durable, easy-to-clean materials are good for rentals, while water-efficient fixtures offer long-term savings.
